place.name: Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro
place.description: Copacabana ( KOH-pə-kə-BAN-ə, US also -⁠BAH-nə; Brazilian Portuguese: [ˌkɔpakaˈbɐnɐ]) is a Brazilian bairro (neighbourhood) located in the South Zone of the city of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. It is most prominently known for its 4 km (2.5 mile) balneario beach, which is one of the most famous in the world.
